topic: Code development and data migration plan
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on code review, merging branches, and updating data processing logic. Initially, [p1] ran a recalculation test, correcting an error where the period was set to one month plus two days instead of the intended two days.

[p1] confirmed that `ml-agg-dev` could be merged into both staging and master environments. During subsequent discussion, [p1] advised removing the parameter `USE_DEVICE_AGG_DEV` and all related conditional logic to ensure the new table is always used.

[me] agreed to simplify the code by making the query run without specific parameters, excluding the need for explicit table names. It was decided that data from 2024 should also be migrated into the new table structure.

[p1] provided instructions on merging: merge to staging and then create a Pull Request (PR) for master after running final two-day test runs.
decisions: The `ml-agg-dev` branch can be merged into both staging and master environments.
The parameter `USE_DEVICE_AGG_DEV` and related conditions will be removed from the code to standardize on the new table structure.
Data for 2024 will be migrated into the new table structure over the weekend.
action_items: [me] needs to push the final code changes and merge them.
[p1] will run final two-day test runs before master PR.
[me] will perform the 2024 data migration on the weekend.
